# HighPassSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HighPassSoundEffect")`

Removes low frequencies and keeps high ones, for a telephone or a small speaker.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Cutoff` | `number` | `500` | read/write | The frequency below which sound is removed, in hertz. |
| `Resonance` | `number` | `0.707` | read/write | How much frequencies near the cutoff are boosted, from 0.1 to 10. 0.707 is flat; higher values ring. |
